mapper.select: -- Load one immutable ACTIVE rule release for a collection run. SELECT ascrr.id AS release_id, ascrr.release_code, asckr.rule_code, ascrg.group_code, ascrg.group_kind_code, atc.category_code AS target_category_code, ast.support_type_code, asckr.strength_code, asckr.is_enabled AS rule_enabled, asckt.term_type_code, asckt.term_text, asckt.match_mode_code, asckt.is_discovery_term, asckt.discovery_order, asckt.is_classification_term, asckt.is_enabled AS term_enabled FROM announcement_source_classification_rule_releases ascrr INNER JOIN announcement_source_classification_rule_groups ascrg ON ascrg.release_id = ascrr.id INNER JOIN announcement_source_classification_keyword_rules asckr ON asckr.group_id = ascrg.id INNER JOIN announcement_source_classification_keyword_terms asckt ON asckt.keyword_rule_id = asckr.id AND asckt.group_id = ascrg.id LEFT JOIN announcement_target_categories atc ON atc.id = ascrg.target_category_id LEFT JOIN announcement_support_types ast ON ast.id = ascrg.support_type_id WHERE ascrr.release_status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND ascrg.is_enabled = TRUE AND asckr.is_enabled = TRUE AND asckt.is_enabled = TRUE AND ( asckt.is_classification_term = TRUE OR ascrg.group_kind_code = 'PROTECTED_METADATA' ) ORDER BY ascrg.sort_order ASC, asckr.sort_order ASC, asckt.term_type_code ASC, asckt.id ASC
mapper.update: -- Pin one immutable rule release and canonical provider search plan to the whole run. UPDATE announcement_source_collection_runs SET rule_release_id = #{ruleReleaseId}, search_plan_hash = #{searchPlanHash}, search_plan_json = CAST(#{searchPlanJson} AS jsonb) WHERE id = #{runId} AND rule_release_id IS NULL
mapper.insert: -- Append immutable source content while making duplicate delivery idempotent. INSERT INTO announcement_source_content_versions ( id, source_id, raw_hash, title, body_text, body_source_code, body_availability_code, source_url, raw_payload_json, collected_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{sourceId}, #{rawHash}, #{title}, #{bodyText}, #{bodySourceCode}, #{bodyAvailabilityCode}, #{sourceUrl}, CAST(#{rawPayloadJson} AS jsonb), #{collectedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (source_id, raw_hash) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: -- Select the canonical hash of the current immutable source content. SELECT ascv.raw_hash FROM announcement_source_content_versions ascv WHERE ascv.source_id = #{sourceId} ORDER BY ascv.collected_at DESC, ascv.created_at DESC, ascv.id DESC LIMIT 1

-- Select the latest immutable source content for an explicit reclassification. SELECT ascv.id AS content_version_id, ascv.source_id, ascv.title, ascv.body_text, ascv.body_source_code, ascv.body_availability_code, ascv.source_url FROM announcement_source_content_versions ascv WHERE ascv.source_id = #{sourceId} ORDER BY ascv.collected_at DESC, ascv.created_at DESC, ascv.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: -- End the previous current evaluation before appending a new decision. UPDATE announcement_source_classification_evaluations SET is_current = FALSE WHERE source_id = #{sourceId} AND is_current = TRUE

-- Preserve confirmed target tags while marking an older evaluation stale. UPDATE announcement_source_confirmed_target_categories SET confirmation_status_code = 'STALE' WHERE source_id = #{sourceId} AND confirmation_status_code = 'CURRENT'

-- Preserve confirmed support tags while marking an older evaluation stale. UPDATE announcement_source_confirmed_support_types SET confirmation_status_code = 'STALE' WHERE source_id = #{sourceId} AND confirmation_status_code = 'CURRENT'
mapper.insert: -- Append the explainable decision for one source content version. INSERT INTO announcement_source_classification_evaluations ( id, source_id, content_version_id, run_id, rule_release_id, engine_version, body_source_code, body_availability_code, title_stage_code, body_stage_code, decision_status_code, reason_code, is_current ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{sourceId}, #{contentVersionId}, #{runId}, #{ruleReleaseId}, #{engineVersion}, #{bodySourceCode}, #{bodyAvailabilityCode}, #{titleStageCode}, #{bodyStageCode}, #{decisionStatusCode}, #{reasonCode}, TRUE )

-- Persist the exact rule term and original title/body offsets used by the engine. INSERT INTO announcement_source_classification_matches ( id, evaluation_id, keyword_rule_id, keyword_term_id, match_location_code, matched_text, start_offset, end_offset, applied_action_code ) SELECT #{id}, #{evaluationId}, asckr.id, asckt.id, #{locationCode}, #{matchedText}, #{startOffset}, #{endOffset}, #{appliedActionCode} FROM announcement_source_classification_keyword_rules asckr INNER JOIN announcement_source_classification_rule_groups ascrg ON ascrg.id = asckr.group_id INNER JOIN announcement_source_classification_keyword_terms asckt ON asckt.keyword_rule_id = asckr.id AND asckt.group_id = ascrg.id WHERE ascrg.release_id = #{ruleReleaseId} AND asckr.rule_code = #{ruleCode} AND asckt.term_text = #{matchedRuleTerm}

-- Persist one automatic target tag by catalog code. INSERT INTO announcement_source_classification_target_matches ( id, evaluation_id, target_category_id ) SELECT #{id}, #{evaluationId}, atc.id FROM announcement_target_categories atc WHERE atc.category_code = #{targetCategoryCode}

-- Persist one automatic support type tag by catalog code. INSERT INTO announcement_source_classification_support_matches ( id, evaluation_id, support_type_id ) SELECT #{id}, #{evaluationId}, ast.id FROM announcement_support_types ast WHERE ast.support_type_code = #{supportTypeCode}
mapper.update:
-- Keep the legacy v1 semantic fields as a current read projection. UPDATE announcement_source_snapshots SET semantic_status_code = #{semanticStatusCode}, semantic_reason_code = #{semanticReasonCode}, semantic_matched_keywords = #{semanticMatchedKeywords}, review_status_code = #{reviewStatusCode}, classification_row_version = classification_row_version + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{sourceId}
AND classification_row_version = #{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: -- Select current classification, optimistic version and manual confirmation freshness. SELECT ass.id AS source_id, asce.id AS decision_id, asce.decision_status_code, asce.reason_code, ass.review_status_code, ass.classification_row_version, ( SELECT count(1) FROM announcement_source_confirmed_target_categories asctc WHERE asctc.source_id = ass.id ) AS confirmed_target_count, ( SELECT count(1) FROM announcement_source_confirmed_support_types ascst WHERE ascst.source_id = ass.id ) AS confirmed_support_count, ( SELECT count(1) FROM ( SELECT asctc.based_on_evaluation_id FROM announcement_source_confirmed_target_categories asctc WHERE asctc.source_id = ass.id UNION ALL SELECT ascst.based_on_evaluation_id FROM announcement_source_confirmed_support_types ascst WHERE ascst.source_id = ass.id ) confirmed WHERE confirmed.based_on_evaluation_id IS DISTINCT FROM asce.id ) AS stale_confirmed_count FROM announcement_source_snapshots ass LEFT JOIN announcement_source_classification_evaluations asce ON asce.source_id = ass.id AND asce.is_current = TRUE WHERE ass.id = #{sourceId}

-- Select the current structured classification without exposing raw payload data. SELECT ass.id AS source_id, asce.id AS decision_id, ascrr.release_code AS rule_release_code, asce.decision_status_code AS semantic_status_code, asce.reason_code, asce.title_stage_code, asce.body_stage_code, asce.body_source_code, asce.body_availability_code, ass.classification_row_version, asce.evaluated_at FROM announcement_source_snapshots ass INNER JOIN announcement_source_classification_evaluations asce ON asce.source_id = ass.id AND asce.is_current = TRUE INNER JOIN announcement_source_classification_rule_releases ascrr ON ascrr.id = asce.rule_release_id WHERE ass.id = #{sourceId}

-- Select explainable title/body matches for the current evaluation. SELECT ascrg.group_code AS rule_group_code, canonical.term_text AS canonical_keyword, ascm.matched_text AS matched_term, ascm.match_location_code AS location_code, ascm.start_offset, ascm.end_offset, ascm.applied_action_code FROM announcement_source_classification_evaluations asce INNER JOIN announcement_source_classification_matches ascm ON ascm.evaluation_id = asce.id INNER JOIN announcement_source_classification_keyword_rules asckr ON asckr.id = ascm.keyword_rule_id INNER JOIN announcement_source_classification_rule_groups ascrg ON ascrg.id = asckr.group_id LEFT JOIN announcement_source_classification_keyword_terms canonical ON canonical.keyword_rule_id = asckr.id AND canonical.term_type_code = 'CANONICAL' WHERE asce.source_id = #{sourceId} AND asce.is_current = TRUE ORDER BY CASE ascm.match_location_code WHEN 'TITLE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, ascm.start_offset ASC, ascrg.sort_order ASC

-- Select target tags produced by the current automatic evaluation. SELECT atc.category_code FROM announcement_source_classification_evaluations asce INNER JOIN announcement_source_classification_target_matches asctm ON asctm.evaluation_id = asce.id INNER JOIN announcement_target_categories atc ON atc.id = asctm.target_category_id WHERE asce.source_id = #{sourceId} AND asce.is_current = TRUE ORDER BY atc.sort_order ASC, atc.category_code ASC

-- Select support tags produced by the current automatic evaluation. SELECT ast.support_type_code FROM announcement_source_classification_evaluations asce INNER JOIN announcement_source_classification_support_matches ascsm ON ascsm.evaluation_id = asce.id INNER JOIN announcement_support_types ast ON ast.id = ascsm.support_type_id WHERE asce.source_id = #{sourceId} AND asce.is_current = TRUE ORDER BY ast.sort_order ASC, ast.support_type_code ASC

-- Select administrator-confirmed target categories for the current source. SELECT atc.category_code FROM announcement_source_confirmed_target_categories asctc INNER JOIN announcement_target_categories atc ON atc.id = asctc.target_category_id WHERE asctc.source_id = #{sourceId} ORDER BY atc.sort_order ASC, atc.category_code ASC

-- Select administrator-confirmed support types for the current source. SELECT ast.support_type_code FROM announcement_source_confirmed_support_types ascst INNER JOIN announcement_support_types ast ON ast.id = ascst.support_type_id WHERE ascst.source_id = #{sourceId} ORDER BY ast.sort_order ASC, ast.support_type_code ASC
mapper.update: -- Acquire optimistic ownership before replacing manual classification tags. UPDATE announcement_source_snapshots SET classification_row_version = classification_row_version + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{sourceId} AND classification_row_version = #{expectedVersion}
mapper.insert: -- Insert one confirmed target category by stable catalog code. INSERT INTO announcement_source_confirmed_target_categories ( id, source_id, target_category_id, based_on_evaluation_id, confirmed_by ) SELECT #{id}, #{sourceId}, atc.id, #{evaluationId}, #{actorUserId} FROM announcement_target_categories atc WHERE atc.category_code = #{targetCategoryCode} AND atc.is_enabled = TRUE

-- Insert one confirmed support type by stable catalog code. INSERT INTO announcement_source_confirmed_support_types ( id, source_id, support_type_id, based_on_evaluation_id, confirmed_by ) SELECT #{id}, #{sourceId}, ast.id, #{evaluationId}, #{actorUserId} FROM announcement_support_types ast WHERE ast.support_type_code = #{supportTypeCode} AND ast.is_enabled = TRUE
